resources.string: A few quick choices to fit Klean to your day. Every page can be skipped, and everything can be changed later in Settings.
Turn on the parts of Klean you want. The rest stays out of the way.
Klean stays quiet in this window. Check-ins wait until you\'re up, and a day runs from waking to sleeping.
A widget shows today at a glance and adds something in one tap.
You can also long-press your home screen, choose Widgets, then Klean.
Long-press your home screen, choose Widgets, then Klean.
These help check-ins arrive on time. Each one is optional, and Klean works without them.
Klean can use an AI service to fill in details about what you ate. Logging always works without it.
You can also do this later in Settings.
